task: Create a Kubernetes cluster architecture at /home/user/Documents/k8s_cluster.drawio. Create 12 shapes: Control Plane, Ingress, Worker1, Worker2, Worker3, Pod1-6, ServiceMesh. Connect hierarchically: Control Plane to each Worker, each Worker to 2 Pods (Worker1->Pod1/2, Worker2->Pod3/4, Worker3->Pod5/6), Ingress to Control Plane. The diagram must have 12 vertices and at least 9 edges. Save the file.
task_grounding: Open the file /home/user/Documents/k8s_cluster.drawio in draw.io Desktop. Create a Kubernetes cluster architecture diagram on page 0. Add exactly 12 shapes with these exact labels: 'Control Plane', 'Ingress', 'Worker1', 'Worker2', 'Worker3', 'Pod1', 'Pod2', 'Pod3', 'Pod4', 'Pod5', 'Pod6', 'ServiceMesh'. Connect them hierarchically: Control Plane must have edges to each of Worker1, Worker2, and Worker3. Each worker has 2 pods connected to it (Worker1->Pod1, Worker1->Pod2, Worker2->Pod3, Worker2->Pod4, Worker3->Pod5, Worker3->Pod6). Also connect Ingress to Control Plane. The diagram must have at least 9 edges total. Save at /home/user/Documents/k8s_cluster.drawio.

verification.prompt: Using the connections list (source/target IDs) and the vertices list (IDs to labels), verify that Control Plane has connecting edges to ALL THREE workers: Worker1, Worker2, and Worker3. Edges may go in either direction. Answer yes only if all three connections exist.
verification.description: Control Plane connects to all 3 workers
